i1.title: Burberry Hero Eau de Toilette 200ml Refill
i1.descriptionHtml:
Top up your Hero bottle with this 200ml refill of juniper, black pepper and cedarwood.

Burberry Hero Eau de Toilette 200ml Refill refills your 100ml Burberry Hero Eau de Toilette bottle. Hero is a woody aromatic fragrance for men: bright bergamot opens onto a trio of cedarwood, with juniper and black pepper adding a crisp, spicy edge. The refill is not a spray and cannot be used on its own.

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Bergamot
  • Heart: Cedarwood
  • Base: Black Pepper, Juniper

How to refill

  • Remove the cap and unscrew the pump from your Hero 100ml bottle.
  • Without opening the refill's cap, screw the refill onto the bottle neck; filling stops when the bottle is full.
  • Unscrew the refill, then put the pump and cap back on.

Key details

  • Brand: Burberry
  • Concentration: Eau de Toilette
  • Size: 200ml refill
  • Fits: Burberry Hero Eau de Toilette 100ml bottle
  • Scent profile: Woody · Aromatic · Spicy
  • Wear: Men

Why you'll love it

  • Refills your Hero bottle with less packaging
  • A bright bergamot opening
  • A signature trio of cedarwood
  • Juniper and black pepper for a crisp, spicy edge

FAQ

What does Hero smell like?

Bergamot first, then cedarwood, finishing with black pepper and juniper.

Can I spray it straight from the refill?

No, it is a refill bottle for the Burberry Hero Eau de Toilette 100ml bottle and cannot be used on its own.

Is it for men?

Yes, it is a men's fragrance.
